rows.title: Mapping the Evidence on Kratom Use, Health Outcomes, and Policy Gaps in the United States: A Scoping Review.
rows.evidence_boundary: A scoping review maps use patterns, outcomes, and policy gaps but does not provide pooled causal estimates; self-report, product variability, and observational evidence remain major limitations.

rows.title: Acute Responses to Creatine Monohydrate and L-Arginine, Alone and Combined, on Repeated-Sprint Power, Countermovement Jump Height, and Stroop Reaction Time in Recreationally Active Men: A Randomized Double-Blind Crossover Trial.
rows.evidence_boundary: This acute crossover trial involved 18 recreationally active men and single-dose conditions; short-term task effects do not establish chronic performance or cognitive benefit.

rows.title: A review on Mitragyna alkaloids pharmacology, biosynthesis and biotechnological insights.
rows.evidence_boundary: The review spans multiple Mitragyna species, alkaloids, pharmacology, and biotechnology; evidence is heterogeneous and should not be generalized to standardized kratom products or clinical outcomes.

rows.title: Micronutrients in Cardiovascular Disease: A Comprehensive Review of Vitamins, Trace Minerals, and Electrolytes.
rows.evidence_boundary: The review aggregates many vitamins, trace minerals, and electrolytes across heterogeneous human evidence; associations and deficiency correction should not be conflated with blanket supplementation benefit.

rows.title: Cannabinoid efficacy for pain: dose, chronicity and route.
rows.evidence_boundary: Analgesic effects and adverse effects vary materially by cannabinoid, dose, route, chronicity, and composition; preclinical THC findings and clinical cannabis evidence are not interchangeable.
